<!-- generated by FlowCast Studio from https://wso2.com/integration-platform/docs/genai/getting-started/build-a-sentiment-analyzer -->

## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `BuildASentimentAnalyzer`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `build-a-sentiment-analyzer`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **BuildASentimentAnalyzer**.

## Step 2: Add an HTTP service

1. <!-- manual: Select your integration from the Project overview canvas. -->
2. In the Design canvas, select **Add Artifact**.
3. Select **HTTP Service** under **Integration as API**.
4. Keep **Service Contract** as **Design From Scratch**.
5. Set **Service Base Path** to `/`.
6. Select **Create**.

## Step 3: Define the Sentiment type

1. <!-- manual: In Project Explorer, click the + next to Types. -->
2. Set **the kind** to **Enum**.
3. Set **Type name** to `Sentiment`.
4. <!-- manual: Add three members: POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, NEUTRAL. -->
5. Select **Save**.

## Step 4: Add a POST resource

1. In the HTTP Service Design editor, select **+ Add Resource**.
2. Select **POST**.
3. Set **Resource Path** to `analyze`.
4. Select **+ Define Payload**.
5. In the popup, select **Create Type Schema**, set the name to `AnalyzePayload`, and add a single field `text` of type `string`.
6. <!-- manual: add a single field text of type string -->
7. Select **Save** on the payload panel, then **Save** on the resource.

## Step 5: Add a direct LLM call

1. Select **+** inside the resource flow.
2. Select **Model Provider** under **Direct LLM**.
3. Select **+ Add Model Provider**.
4. Select **WSO2 Model Provider**.
5. Keep the default name and select **Save**. The provider is added under **Connections**.
6. Select **Generate** action.
7. Set **Prompt** to `Classify the sentiment of this customer review and provide a confidence score between 0.0 and 1.0 indicating how confident you are in the classification. Review: ${payload.text}`.
8. <!-- manual: Review: ${payload.text} -->
9. Set the result variable name to `sentimentResult`.
10. For **Expected Type**, create a new record type `SentimentResult` with two fields: `sentiment` of type `Sentiment` and `confidence` of type `float`. Select **Save** in the type creator.
11. Back in the Generate panel, select `SentimentResult` in the **Expected Type** field, then select **Save**.

## Step 6: Return the result

1. Select **+** below the **ai:generate** node.
2. Select **Return**.
3. Set **Expression** to `sentimentResult`.
4. Select **Save**.

## Step 7: Run and test

1. Select **Run** in the toolbar.
2. Select **Try It** in the confirmation dialog.
3. Wait 8 seconds.
4. <!-- manual: Send a POST to /analyze with the body {"text": "Absolutely loved this product! Best purchase I made all year."}. -->
5. Confirm the response includes `"sentiment":"POSITIVE"` along with a `confidence` score.
